content: Mbole ya apo, nikikibhona kitabho mukibhoko kyake kya nnilo kya yula ywakatamite mukiteho kila kya ghubhutwa. Kitabho kila kikityekwa malembo pakati na panji na kikinyengwa kwa kimatiko kiibheghite na mango saba.
Kangi, nikimmona lihoka yuna makakala pakalandamiha kwa lilobhe likulu, “Ghani ywakateghekwa kumakatula ahyo himatiko na kukihughula kitabho akyo?”
Kangi pakibhegha ng'obhe mundu ghwa akwo kunani kwa Chapanga, ebu munnima ebu pahi kumambe ywakahotolite kukihughula kitabho akyo ebu kukilolekeha unyumba.
Basi, nenga nikilila muno kiyaha kakibhonekana ng'obhe mundu ywakanoghwitwe kukihughula akyo kitabho ebu kukibhona unyumba.

Mbole, yumu ywa bhala aghohi kaking'ombela, “Ghukotoke kulila. Ghulole! Lihimba kuhuma mulikabila lya Yuda, ywa kibheleko kya mutwa Daudi kahotola. Ywombe kanguhotola kumakatula himatiko ahyo saba na kukihughula kitabho akyo.”

Mbole, nikimmona Mwanamene kayima pakati ugheghela na kiteho kila kya ghghubhutwa, katindilwa mbande hyoha na hila hibhumbe ncheche hina ubhumi na bhala aghohi. Aywo Mwanamene kakibhonekana handa ywakahinjitwe. Kakibhegha na mipalapi saba na meho saba, hyene ndo Mihuki saba hya Chapanga hiilaghilitwe munnima ghwoha.
Mwanamene aywo kakighenda na kukitola kila kitabho kuhuma mu kibhoko kya nnilo kya yula ywakatamite mu kiteho kya ghghubhutwa.

Mbole ya Mwanamene kukitola kitabho kila, bhala hibhumbe ncheche hina ubhumi papamu na bhala hilongohi ishilini na ncheche bhakighwegha pahi muulongolo ghwa Mwanamene. Kila yumu kakibhegha na ligombo lyake na kila yumu kukamulila bakuli lya lihabha liimemite ubanu lya kunungila, ubanu aghwo ndo mayupo gha bhandu bha Chapanga.
Basi, bhombe bhakiyimba luyimbo alu lwa hyono.

content.text: Kiyaha ghwenga ghukihinjwa, na kwa mwahi ghwa kiho kyako, ghwenga ghukibhayegha bhandu kwa Chapanga.
Ghwenga ghukibhayegha bhandu kuhuma mu kila likabila, kila nongelo hya bhandu, kila nnima na aghanja.
Ghwenga ghubhatenda bhombe abheghe ghubhutwa ghwa undundame ili bhantumikile chapanga ghwetu,
na bhombe bhatatabhala bandu bhoha munnima.”

content: Mbole, panolekehite nikiyihwa malobhe gha mahoka atangalo ngenju, bhakiyima kukitindila kiteho kila kya ghghubhutwa, papamu na bhala hibhumbe ncheche bhanaubhumi na bhala aghohi,
nabho bhakiyimba kwa lilobhe likulu paalongela.

content.text: likalama na utopelo na malango na makakala,

content: Hila hila nikiyihwa hibhumbe hyoha hya kunani na hya munnima na hya pahi ya nnima na hya mulihibha, bhoha bhakibhegha bhanguyimba,

content.text: “Litiko na uhokamo na ukulu na makakala ghoha,
Ghabheghe kwa ywombe ywakatamite mu kiteho kya ghghubhutwa kwa Mwana mene manjubha kyanga uhiko.”

content: Hibhumbe bhala ncheche bhanaubhumi bhakilongela, “Mwika.” Na bhala aghohi bhakighwegha makukama pahi na bhakitundamila.
